clips.title: The story
paras: In Loch Modan, Trogg Stone Tooth comes from the Stonesplinter troggs in the hills. Rugged and mineralized, each tooth gives dwarven defenders proof that the troggs are being hunted along the southern frontier.

Captain Rugelfuss calls for volunteers to hunt the Stonesplinter troggs near Loch Modan's southern gate. With the Ironforge Reserve committed to the Alliance Front, local dwarven garrisons are stretched thin across Khaz Modan. Rugelfuss cannot spare the soldiers at the southern gate guard tower for patrols in the nearby hills. His standing call asks volunteers to hunt the lurking troggs and bring back Trogg Stone Teeth as crude, undeniable proof of each beast slain.
